sloka: सुप्तमे वोद्गतप्राणमन्तः पुरमन्यत ।ततः प्रचुक्रुशुर् दीनाः सस्वरम् ता वर अन्गनाः ॥२-६५-२०॥
transliteration: suptame vodgataprāṇamantaḥ puramanyata ।tataḥ pracukruśur dīnāḥ sasvaram tā vara anganāḥ ॥2-65-20॥

translations.english: Then those women bewailed bitterly and loudly in distress like female elephants in the forest when their leader has fallen out of the herd.
